lane_top_down_model.note: ft = a * s + b with s rescaled so the ball at pin_hit reads 60 ft (a = a_fit / s_pin)

series_rule: jump rule: raw boards on frames >= cut pin_hit-2 are walked in order against the last kept raw board (seed = median of the 3 raw boards before); a frame more than 6.0 + 1.0 x (frames skipped) boards from it is dropped from boards and lane_top_down (kept in boards_raw); boards = 3-frame median of the cleaned raw; final_board = composition fit_path entry (Theil-Sen over cut pin_hit-10..pin_hit at cut pin_hit) on the cleaned series

how.pin_row_frame_est: first non-coasted ball frame >= release+8 whose centre y is at/above the headpin base row (midpoint of the pin column top and the edge pd row, 3-frame median), held on the next real frame with >= 3 real frames after it; fallback cuts.json pin_hit
how.entry_board: Theil-Sen over boards (3-frame median, cleaned) on pin_row-6..pin_row-1, evaluated at pin_row; entry_board_raw = cleaned raw board at pin_row
how.exit_frame: last non-coasted, moving (not deck_decoy) ball frame >= pin_row with a board; exit_board = boards there; exit_kind pit when the ball bottom is at/behind the back-row base row (headpin base moved 2.6 ft back through the edge vanishing point), else hidden; deck depth: frames pin_row..exit spread linearly from 60 ft to 62.6 (pit) or 61.3 (hidden)
how.deck_frames: non-coasted moving ball frames with a board from pin_row to exit
how.deflection: sign of exit_board - entry_board, dead band 2 boards (straight through inside it)
how.breakpoint_ft: ft_cv at the minimum of the 5-frame median of the cleaned raw boards over release..pin_row; breakpoint_at_roll_end = minimum in the first/last 2 roll frames (no measurable hook back)
how.ft_cv: 60 * (f - release) / (pin_row_frame_est - release); release is the cuts.json input
how.deck_decoy_from: first non-coasted ball point at/after pin_row-1 whose camera-compensated drift to every real point in the next 3 frames is < 3.0 px (a static purple patch in the pit/kickback, truth notes finding 5; threshold read off the drift table: moving >= 3.4, static <= 2.4); frames from it on do not count for exit, deck frames or the last real frame
how.gutter: >= 5 SAM points kept inside one gutter channel by the per-frame lane-first fit within the last 15 frames of the track (ends f434; late median 1.39 not outside 0.5..39.5); side right = boards below 0.5
how.entry_board_crossing: board at the sub-frame crossing of the headpin base row: linear interpolation of the cleaned boards at the two real points bracketing the row (t* from centre y vs the 3-frame-median row), else Theil-Sen over the last 6 cleaned boards before the pin row at t*; it is entry_board only when entry_n < 2

gutter.rule: >= 5 SAM points kept inside one gutter channel by the per-frame lane-first fit within the last 15 frames of the track (ends f434; late median 1.39 not outside 0.5..39.5)

events.entry_crossing_how: no real crossing at the pin row: t* = pin row; Theil-Sen over the last 6 cleaned boards before the pin row at t*

final_board_rule: Theil-Sen over boards in pin_hit-10..pin_hit evaluated at pin_hit (composition fit_path), on the series after clean_series

pin_row_pass2.trigger: pass 1 pin row fell back (pin motion: first camera-compensated rack motion f485 - 2); track ended f437

why: pin row fell back (geometric, gutter evidence): SAM forward pass to the cut end (k132) instead of cut pin_hit + 12
J4 fails (dead-band sign changes 2, max jump 2.46) and 8 SAM deck points deviate > 2.0 boards from the residual chain: gate SAM deck points (depth >= 55.0 ft) to within 2.0 boards
pin row still fell back after the SAM pass to the cut end: deck re-seed of SAM from the last residual detection

deck_reseed_sam.trigger: no held headpin-row crossing after the SAM pass to the cut end
deck_reseed_sam.prompt_rule: last residual point within 6 frames of the track end (f432), else the last real point; crop 28.0 x r_geo clamped 128..480 px, upscaled to ~768 px; SAM 2 propagated to the cut end, gated and merged by the unchanged radius/lateral gates

entry_crossing.trigger: fewer than 2 cleaned boards in pin_row-6..pin_row-1 (entry_n 0)
entry_crossing.rule: entry = board interpolated at the sub-frame headpin-row crossing (bracketing real points), else a Theil-Sen line over the last 6 cleaned boards before the pin row evaluated at t*
entry_crossing.how: no real crossing at the pin row: t* = pin row; Theil-Sen over the last 6 cleaned boards before the pin row at t*

fallback_rules.dark_seed: no chained residual seed: dark-disc matched filter inside the lane-first lane seeds the chain
fallback_rules.pin_row_pass2: pass 1 pin_row_source startswith fallback (or geometric fallback with gutter evidence): SAM to the cut end
fallback_rules.pin_row_relaxed_hold: still fallback after the SAM pass to the cut end and 3 consecutive real points at/above the base row exist
fallback_rules.deck_reseed_sam: still fallback after the SAM pass to the cut end: SAM re-prompted on the last residual detection within 6 frames of the track end in a 28.0 x r_geo crop
fallback_rules.pin_row_gutter_crossing: no held crossing and >= 5 of the last 15 track frames in one gutter channel (lane-first): pin row at the extrapolated (<= 3 frames) base-row crossing
fallback_rules.deck_gate: J4 fails and SAM deck points deviate > 2.0 boards from the residual chain: those points rejected
fallback_rules.entry_crossing: entry_n < 2: entry_board = board at the sub-frame headpin-row crossing
fallback_rules.late_jump_reclean: 5-frame median jump > 3.0 boards in 15 ft..pin row
fallback_rules.gutter: late median of 10 roll boards outside 0.5..39.5; SAM lateral gate waived inside one channel (9.0 boards wide); lane-first channel over all real points when no held crossing or the entry is outside the lane
